key: Learning to cook. Part I is knowing your
name: ch01_cooking_school_three_parts
alt: A cooking student moves from her own small kitchen, to a chain of branch kitchens with the same menu, to a big central kitchen sending sauce to all branches.
scene: A wide illustration read left to right as three steps on one learning path, joined by a dotted footpath along the bottom. STEP ONE, on the left: a young cooking student in her early 20s, hair tied back, plain green apron, stands in a small home kitchen; she holds up a recipe card while looking into an open fridge with neatly labelled shelves, a pantry rack of jars beside her, and on the counter a stack of round steel tiffin boxes being packed and clipped shut so food survives the trip. A tick mark floats over a cooked dish to show she knows what 'done' means. STEP TWO, in the middle: three small branch kitchens side by side, each with an identical menu board showing the same three food icons, and a cook in each one plating the same dish; thin phone lines connect the branches. STEP THREE, on the right: one large central kitchen with three huge steaming pots of sauce, a helper ladling sauce into sealed tubs that ride out on a delivery van, with dashed arrows from the van to the three branches in the middle. The same student appears in all three steps, a little older and more confident each time, ending in a head-chef jacket. Warm daylight, optimistic mood. Labels: "PART I" above the home kitchen, "PART II" above the branches, "PART III" above the central kitchen.

key: A compute-intensive job is a chess grandmaster
name: ch01_chess_vs_reservation_office
alt: Split scene: a chess grandmaster alone over one board beside a crowded railway reservation office where clerks handle huge numbers of simple bookings.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel, quiet and spacious: an elderly chess grandmaster (grey beard, brown sleeveless sweater over a white shirt) sits alone at a small table under one hanging lamp, both hands pressed to his temples, staring at a chessboard with only a handful of pieces; a big thought bubble above him is packed with branching dotted move-lines and a small gear icon spinning fast, to show heavy thinking about very little data. RIGHT panel, crowded and busy: the inside of a railway reservation office seen from behind the counter. Three clerks in white shirts each stamp a simple paper booking slip, a tiny 'plus one' sum on each slip to show the arithmetic is easy. In front of the counter stretches a huge crowd of passengers with forms, and behind the clerks a wall of tall shelves is crammed with thick ledgers; a big departure board above shows rows of trains and waitlist numbers flipping. A sturdy steel safe beside the shelves has a padlock and a green tick, to show no booking may ever be lost. Thin arrows show slips flowing from the crowd into the ledgers. Soft lamp light on the left, bright busy office light on the right. Labels: "COMPUTE" at the top of the left panel, "DATA" at the top of the right panel.

key: Lunch tiffins travel from homes to offices
name: ch01_dabbawala_whole_chapter
alt: Dabbawalas carry colour-coded tiffins along a railway route to office towers, with one carrier stepping in for a sick colleague and a new route being added.
scene: A wide panorama of a tiffin delivery network across a big Indian city at late morning, read left to right. LEFT: a row of homes where women hand round steel tiffins to two dabbawalas in white kurta-pyjamas and white caps; one dabbawala sits on a doorstep with a thermometer and a blanket, sick, while his colleague smiles and lifts his crate onto his own head, so the tiffins still go. CENTRE: a station platform where a local train waits; carriers sort tiffins into crates by the painted colour-and-number codes on their lids, and a large close-up inset bubble shows one lid with a simple code of a coloured stripe and a short number. A team leader in a slightly darker cap stands on a crate holding a clipboard, looking over a chalk route board where every box has a dot, to show he can see where everything is. RIGHT: office towers with a brand-new tower still wrapped in scaffolding, and a fresh dashed route line is being chalked onto the route board towards it while two extra carriers in new caps join that route. Dotted arrows trace one tiffin's journey from a home kitchen, through the train, to an office desk. Bright, busy, cheerful mood under warm sunlight. Labels: "RELIABLE" over the sick carrier and his colleague, "SCALABLE" over the new tower route, "MAINTAINABLE" over the coded lid inset.
